finish.summary: Built closed single-cell enclosure from full hex base with solid top cover and all six side caps. Installed Port louvre (hex-port-louvre) in side port slot for breathing. Props staged beside enclosure. Configurator checks fit only - no claim about waterproofing, material, or thermal performance.

events.text: Sealed electronics box coming up — I'll fit a louvred vent so the board can breathe while staying protected.
